svg.title: Claude Code with the HTMLRadar plugin: who read the QA smoke deck
svg.text: claude — htmlradar plugin
> Did anyone read the QA smoke deck (share b3051639-0cad-4792-94d1-5e7898f8c5e4)? Which sections
did they spend time on?
● I'll pull the activity for that share from HTMLRadar.
● htmlradar - get_share_activity (share_id: "b3051639-0cad-4792-94d1-5e7898f8c5e4")
⎿ Share b3051639-0cad-4792-94d1-5e7898f8c5e4 — https://htmlradar.com/r/qa-smoke-deck
Opened: yes — 3 viewers
● Yes, the QA smoke deck was opened by three people, all on 23 July 2026 at about 19:07 UTC (they
opened it within the same second, which fits a scripted smoke test rather than three humans
arriving independently).
Who read it and how far they got
Viewer Active time Scrolled Sections that held their attention
priya@harbor.example 8 seconds 66% of the page "What 'passes' means" (2.8 s), "Why this
content matters" (3.1 s)
alex@northstar.example 12 seconds 93% of the page "What 'passes' means" (2.8 s), "Why this
content matters" (3.1 s), "The end of
the test deck" (3.3 s)
daniel@aperture.example 8 seconds 66% of the page "What 'passes' means" (2.8 s), "Why this
content matters" (3.0 s)
What stands out
- Every viewer spent roughly three seconds each on the two opening sections, "What 'passes' means"
and "Why this content matters". Those are the only sections anyone lingered on.
- Only Alex scrolled far enough to reach "The end of the test deck", which is why they show 93%
scroll and a third section. Priya and Daniel both stopped at about two thirds of the way down.
- Daniel's tab stayed open until 19:10, about three and a half minutes after the others closed
theirs, but their active time was still only 8 seconds, so the page was open in the background
rather than being read.
> How many free HTMLRadar links do I have left?
● I'll check your HTMLRadar account status with its `whoami` tool.
● htmlradar - whoami
⎿ HTMLRadar account 98cefd41-1f0f-4055-a4a0-dff236d7df3a
Plan: free
Free tracked links used: 2 of 2
● You have 0 free HTMLRadar links left.

- Plan: free

another HTML document as a tracked link, you will need to upgrade the account to a paid plan
first. I did not create any new shares, so nothing has changed on your account.
